text:
Ava: quick Friday check-in — thanks everyone for the push this sprint. A few top asks heading into next week: 1) confirm GA launch readiness checklist (security + docs + migration guide). 2) firm SLA targets for Dedicated (p95 latency goal and SLO burn rate). 3) fallback/degenerate plan if we hit cross-region capacity limits. Please reply with owners and carry-by dates.

Maya: assigned to collate launch checklist items. I'll own the docs + migration guide. aiming for EOD Tue to handoff to support. @Kiran can you validate integrations?

Kiran: yep will run through the top 5 customer flows Mon morning. I found one edge-case with session tokens last run, will log an item.

Ravi: I'll own SLA targets. Proposal: Dedicated p95 <= 220ms for 8k seq typical, p99 fallback <= 600ms when autoscale engaged. If that sounds ok I'll formalize and send to legal/security for signoff by Wed.

Jules: SRE will provide canary plan + rollback steps. quick note: we need a constrained memory profile for the quantized 4-bit variant otherwise OOM risks on older instances.

Sam: support readiness — training doc + playbook will be ready Wed AM. I'll include common escalations and a short runbook for the top 6 errors.

Ava: on fallback/degenerate plan — we should have automatic routing to lower-cost region + model-variant fallback, and an opt-in feature flag to preserve high-priority customers. @Ravi @Jules coordinate on routing/rate limits.

Ravi: agree. I'll add a routing policy: primary -> Dedicated (region A), secondary -> Hosted small-capacity (region B), tertiary -> quantized-variant with reduced context. Will submit config by Tue EOD.

Jules: plan to run a small-scale canary tonight (20 users) and a 10-minute load burst sim tomorrow. Deploy steps below:

```
canary deploy:
- set env VAR_CANARY=1
- route weight 5%
- monitor p95/p99, error-rate
- if error-rate > 1% rollback
```

deploy-bot: Canary started at 1829001400. weight=5%

deploy-bot: Canary progress: 30m in, p95=210ms, p99=520ms, errors=0.4% :thumbsup:

Kiran: logged session-token edge-case as ISSUE-423. Short repro attached to the ticket.

Maya: for launch comms — feature matrix and partner notes done. Need marketing assets by Thu. @Sam pls coordinate FAQ.

Sam: will sync with marketing Tue and share draft FAQ by Wed.

Ava: two metrics to watch next week: 1) cost per 1M tokens (platform avg) 2) SLO burn (weekly). If cost drift > 8% flag for review.

Ravi: adding a small change to batching defaults to tighten token cost. I'll run a benchmark and post numbers Tues.

Jules: after canary completes we'll run a 2-hour soak on Wed. scheduling now.

Ava: final ask — Heads: please push any blockers to this thread before EOD Mon. We'll do a 15min sync Tue 10:30 PT to lock the plan. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
